PMos -- a real OS that runs inside a browser tab.

This product builds on the ideas and work of the free software
community. In particular:

- The Wayland project, whose wire-protocol design informs the
  PMos display protocol.
- The WebAssembly and WASI communities, whose preview-1 ABI is
  the baseline syscall surface PMos extends from.
- The Linux kernel's process / VFS / IPC models, whose
  conventions PMos mirrors for userland compatibility.

The project constitution (see .specify/memory/constitution.md)
codifies the ten principles that shape every design choice.

For a complete list of PMos contributors, see the repository's
commit history.
